The hedge fund run by Leighton Welch held 18,597 shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.21M, down from 29,983 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Welch Capital Partners Llc who had been investing in Alibaba Group Holding for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $499.40 billion market cap company.
